answer: Locks are recorded in wharf, expire in nectar, and trellis lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 157 aliases hence needs 33 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2631 identities would post 1712 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
